_comment: Copy to config/config.json and fill in. Non-secret only. Values from ScrambleID: consent.baseUrl, consent.tenant, auth.tokenEndpoint, auth.issuer, auth.clientId. Values you own: callbackPolicy.*. Secrets (private key) are mounted as files, never placed here.

auth._auth_alternatives: To use clientCredentials: set mode=clientCredentials, keep tokenEndpoint + clientId, and mount the secret via AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE. To use static: set mode=static and mount a pre-obtained token via UPSTREAM_TOKEN_FILE. In both cases remove the privateKeyJwt-only fields (issuer, signingAlg, assertionTtlSeconds).

callbackPolicy._comment: Controls where the proxy may deliver. Empty allowedHosts = deny all. The resolved address must fall within allowedCidrs; loopback/link-local/metadata are always blocked.

_callback_auth_comment: OPTIONAL. Leave this whole block out (or mechanism=none) and NO callback bearer is sent — the proxy NEVER reuses the upstream ScrambleID M2M token for callbacks. To authenticate deliveries, set a mechanism to mint a DEDICATED callback token from a ScrambleID OR your own auth server, and set CALLBACK_AUTH_ORIGIN. NOTE: setting CALLBACK_AUTH_ORIGIN WITHOUT a mechanism now FAILS STARTUP. Non-secret fields only — the private key / client secret are mounted as files (see .env.example and docker-compose.yml). To enable, replace the block below with ONE of the two examples and remove the leading underscore from the key name (rename _callback to callback).
_callback_discovery_note: Either mechanism may use OIDC discovery INSTEAD of a hand-configured tokenEndpoint: set discoveryUrl to the auth server's .well-known/openid-configuration and the proxy reads the token endpoint from it (once, cached, HTTPS-only + SSRF-guarded). If BOTH discoveryUrl and tokenEndpoint are set, the explicit tokenEndpoint wins. jwksUri is optional and informational/override only (your receiver validates tokens, not the proxy).

auth_privateKeyJwt_discovery_example._note: Alternative to tokenEndpoint: the token endpoint (and, if absent here, the assertion aud) come from the discovery document.

auth_clientCredentials_discovery_example._note: Alternative to tokenEndpoint: the token endpoint comes from the discovery document. jwksUri is optional/informational.
